datePolicy: All source access dates November 7, 2026 explicitly stated in original sources.md. Publication/effective dates remain source-specific and unknown if absent. No research refresh, new quote or policy update implied.
uncertainties: Condo permission, metering category, transformer/cable capacity, compliant installed scope and final billing unknown; THB45,000, THB30,000–80,000 and condo6.00 are assumptions.
MEA-specific tariff/Ft, current Thai VAT primary instrument, January–April 2027 Ft, DLT weight/class/cc and OIC statutory checks remain open.
Exact 2027 incentive/excise instruments/exceptions, VIN entitlement and delivered retail prices unknown. Never deduct subsidy twice or add reported 35% mechanically.
Only BYD/Toyota numerical seating primary-supported. MG/Honda/Mazda numerical seat counts, Toyota E20 and Toyota/Mazda cc still unresolved; Mazda E20 supplement is supported.
Insurance, service, tyres and resale are allowances; consumption is not measured. Resale35/50/45 percent is broad judgment, not completed Thai sales. Mileage sensitivities isolate energy only.

Actual finance approval/fees, warranty terms and insurance exclusions, station uptime/queues and time cost unresolved. Existing common costs, registration/admin and unexpected repairs excluded, not free.
Historical browser-cleanliness exception retained; no new source authentication or visual/build certification.

audience.en: Bangkok resident families comparing Thai-market EV, hybrid and petrol cars and condo charging, using a Bang Na family of four and early-2027 finance assumptions.

audience.th: ครอบครัวที่อาศัยในกรุงเทพฯ ที่กำลังเปรียบเทียบรถ EV ไฮบริด และเบนซินในตลาดไทย พร้อมการชาร์จที่คอนโด โดยใช้ตัวอย่างครอบครัวสี่คนที่บางนาและสมมติฐานการเงินช่วงต้นปี 2027
